business_summary: Saimo Technology Co.,Ltd. provides intelligent detection products and control systems in China and internationally. The company offers weighing products, including high-precision belt scales, floating scale belt scales, coal weighing feeders, weighing feeders, batching systems, checking equipment, weighing instruments/load cells, and other measuring equipment; sampling systems, such as sweep sampling, auger sampling, sample preparation and analytics, and coal sample transportation systems; and conveyor protection products comprising run off, safety pull, position, tilt, and under-speed switches, as well as belt damage detectors and motion monitor systems. It also provides flexible and bulk packaging lines; multi-head and linear weighers; auger and volumetric cup fillers; open mouth, valve bag, bulk bag, and premade bag packers, as well as vertical form fill seals, bulk bag dischargers, and vacuum loaders; checkweigher and metal detector inspection products; robotic, low level, and high-level palletizers; and bucket elevators, inclined and screw conveyors, turn tables, take-off and bet conveyors, and chain conveyors. In addition, the company offers spare parts and manuals, and field and training services; and industrial handling robots, quantitative packaging machinery, large bag packaging machines, vertical packaging machines, multi-head combination scales, weight inspection scales, metal detectors, and other products. Further, it provides pillow bag, tray, carton, bottle, open mouth bag, and bulk bag solutions for the dry and processed food, fresh food, frozen food, liquid and thick, and nonfood industries; and bulk handling solutions for the power, chemical, cement, steel, metallurgy, port, coal, and quarry industries. The company was formerly known as Saimo Electric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Saimo Technology Co.,Ltd. in May 2020. Saimo Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Xuzhou, China.
